day_local: NgoMgqibelo weVeki yamashumi amathathu anesibini ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Kwanga ubabalo noxolo lukaThixo uYise neNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu lungaba nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
psalm_response: Noyikekayo uya kuba nenzala enamandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu emi emnyango, elinde into ebalulekileyo. Mhlawumbi ulinde umntu omthandayo, okanye ulinde impendulo eya kutshintsha yonke into. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ngomfazi owayengayeki ukunkqonkqoza emnyango womgwebi owayengafuni nokuva. 'Render a just decision for me against my adversary.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Lo mfazi akazange anikele. Wayesazi ukuba unelungelo, wayesazi ukuba udinga ubulungisa, kwaye wayekulungele ukubuyela emva nangemva, nangona umgwebi wayemjongela phantsi. UYesu usebenzisa lo mfanekiso ukuze asifundise ngento enzima kakhulu: ukuthandaza ngaphandle kokudinwa. Kodwa ngaba oku kuthetha ukuba kufuneka simnyanzele uThixo? Hayi. Kuthetha ukuba kufuneka sihlale ecaleni kwakhe, nokuba iintliziyo zethu zinzima kangakanani.

UBenjamin Vo wayeyiqonda le nyaniso ngendlela ebalaseleyo. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukujonga iinqwelo-moya, ngakumbi i-Boeing 737. Wayehlala ehleli nobawo wakhe, bejonge phezulu, bebona indlela ezi nqwelo-moya zihamba ngayo, zisuka emhlabeni ziye kude. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubala imigama, ukuyila iinkqubo ze-AI, nokucinga ngale nkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines' eyayimenza agcigcise kwaye amomotheke ngalo lonke ixesha ethetha ngayo. Kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, uBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayinezimvo ezicacileyo. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukunika—njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengumfana owayesazi ukuba ubomi abukho kwizinto esizigcinayo, kodwa kuthando esilunika abanye.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.' UThixo akahlali kude; uphi nawe kule ntlupheko, ekuphatha njengoko umama ephatha umntwana wakhe.

KwiNcwadi kaYohane namhlanje, sifunda amazwi asikhumbuza indlela yokuphila: 'Beloved, you are faithful in all you do for the brothers and sisters, especially for strangers.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYohane uthetha ngendlela uThixo asibiza ngayo ukuba siphile ngokuthandana, ngokuhamba enyanisweni. UBen wayeyiphila le nto. Wayengumfana owayeyihlonipha inyaniso, owayehlonipha abazali bakhe, kwaye owayehlala enentliziyo ehlambulukileyo. Wayengumfana owayengafuni ukuzibonakalisa njengomntu omkhulu, kodwa owayefuna ukuba ngumntwana kaThixo ophilayo. UBen wayengumzekelo wendlela yokuhamba 'enyanisweni' apho uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo. UBen wayeyazi ukuba ukunceda abanye, nokuba ngabantu ongabaziyo, kukuphila kwenyaniso kaKristu.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kule Ntsikelelo, kwaye ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Njengoko ndingenako ukukwamkela ngoku ngokwesi sakramente, nceda uze entliziyweni yam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, ndize ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ngoxolo lwakhe olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyisweni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasezintlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Sithandwa, uthembekile kuko konke okwenzayo kubazalwana nakubadade, ngakumbi kubaphambukeli; baye bangqina ngothando lwakho phambi kweCawa. Nceda ubancedise ngendlela efanele uThixo ukuze baqhubeke nohambo lwabo. Kuba baphuma ngenxa yeGama, kwaye abamkeli nto kubangcwele-mali. Ngoko ke, simele sibaxhase abanjalo, ukuze sibe ngabasebenzi kunye enyanisweni.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Noyikekayo uya kuba nenzala enamandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka. Onwabile umntu oyoyikayo uYehova, oyakuthandayo kakhulu imiyalelo yakhe. Inzala yakhe iya kuba namandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka. R. Noyikekayo uya kuba nenzala enamandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka. Ubutyebi nobunewunewu buya kuba sendlini yakhe, kwaye ubulungisa bakhe buya kuhlala ngonaphakade. Ukukhanya kuyakhanya ebumnyameni kwabathe tye; unenceba, unomusa, kwaye unobulungisa. R. Noyikekayo uya kuba nenzala enamandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka. Onwabile umntu onobubele obolekayo, oqhuba imicimbi yakhe ngobulungisa; akayi kushukunyiswa naphakade; olungileyo uya kukhunjulwa ngonaphakade. R. Noyikekayo uya kuba nenzala enamandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana sabathe tye siya kuthamsanqeleka.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wabaxelela abafundi bakhe umzekeliso malunga nesidingo sokuba bathandaze rhoqo ngaphandle kokudinwa. Wathi, 'Kwakukho umgwebi kwidolophu ethile owayengoyiki Thixo, engahloniphi mntu. Kwakukho umhlolokazi kuleyo dolophu owayesiza kuye athi, "Ndidlele ubulungisa kumchasi wam." Ixesha elide umgwebi wayengavumi, kodwa ekugqibeleni wacinga, "Nangona ndingoyiki Thixo, ndingahloniphi mntu, ngenxa yokuba lo mhlolokazi endikhathaza, ndiya kumenzela ubulungisa ukuze angade eze kundibetha." INkosi yathi, "Phulaphulani okuthethwa ngumgwebi ongenabulungisa. Ngaba uThixo akayi kubenzela ubulungisa abanyuliweyo bakhe abakhala kuye imini nobusuku? Ngaba uya kucotha ukubaphendula? Ndithi kuni, uya kubenzela ubulungisa ngokukhawuleza. Kodwa xa uNyana woMntu esiza, uya kufumana ukholo emhlabeni?"'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
